reference.code:
def decode_frames(data: bytes) -> list[bytes] | None:
    out=[];i=0
    while i<len(data):
        n=data[i];i+=1
        if len(data)-i<n+1:return None
        payload=data[i:i+n];i+=n
        if data[i]!=sum(payload)%256:return None
        i+=1;out.append(payload)
    return out
